daas-irab:1-3.t: ﴿الر﴾ these letters and their like have no grammatical position. ﴿كِتابٌ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو"; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْزَلْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزلناه. ﴿لِتُخْرِجَ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of causation, its fāʿil being latent (mustatir); an and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by the lām, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to أنزلناه. ﴿النَّاسَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الظُّلُماتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تخرج. ﴿إِلَى النُّورِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تخرج. ﴿بِإِذْنِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تخرج. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلى صِراطِ﴾ a badal (substitute) of إلى النور. ﴿الْعَزِيزِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْحَمِيدِ﴾ an adjective. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, badal of العزيز. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ in the position of genitive as an adjective. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mubtadaʾ; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the ṣila of ما. ﴿وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to ما في السموات, and parsed like it. ﴿وَوَيْلٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِلْكافِرِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ عَذابٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ويل. ﴿شَدِيدٍ﴾ an adjective. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَسْتَحِبُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative, with no grammatical position. ﴿الْحَياةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective, accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿عَلَى الْآخِرَةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يستحبون. ﴿وَيَصُدُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يصدون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيَبْغُونَها﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عِوَجاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ; the kāf is a particle of address. ﴿فِي ضَلالٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar. ﴿بَعِيدٍ﴾ an adjective; the clause is the khabar of الذين.

daas-irab:4-5.t: ﴿وَما أَرْسَلْنا﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negative, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿رَسُولٍ﴾ a noun, genitive in form and accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِلِسانِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿قَوْمِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِيُبَيِّنَ﴾ the lām is causal (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of causation; [the lām and what follows it] are attached to يبين, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). «[Translator's note: so in the source ("attached to يبين"); the sense requires attachment to أرسلنا.]» ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يبين. ﴿فَيُضِلُّ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَنْ يَشاءُ﴾ man is a relative, mafʿūl bihi, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشاءُ﴾ parsed like the preceding. ﴿وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its two khabars (predicates); the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنا﴾ the lām occurs in the response of the oath, and qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); the oath clause has no grammatical position; أرسلنا is a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مُوسى﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أرسلنا; nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنْ أَخْرِجْ﴾ an is explicative (mufassira), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿قَوْمَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is explicative, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنَ الظُّلُماتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخرج. ﴿إِلَى النُّورِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخرج. ﴿وَذَكِّرْهُمْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِأَيَّامِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ذكرهم. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. «[Translator's note: so written in the source; the verse reads إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ.]» ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative, the lām is for distance and the kāf for address; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and آيات is the noun of inna, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is causal, with no grammatical position. ﴿لِكُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿صَبَّارٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿شَكُورٍ﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:6-8.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of resumption, and idh is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر". ﴿قالَ مُوسى﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِقَوْمِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قال; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اذْكُرُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿نِعْمَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿أَنْجاكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, its fāʿil being latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ آلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنجاكم. ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa because it is a diptote, being a proper name and foreign. ﴿يَسُومُونَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿سُوءَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْعَذابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَيُذَبِّحُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَبْناءَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِساءَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَفِي ذلِكُمْ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿بَلاءٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of بلاء; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾ a second adjective; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَإِذْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and idh is an adverb of time. ﴿تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَئِنْ﴾ the lām paves the way for the omitted oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and in is conditional. ﴿شَكَرْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ﴾ the lām occurs in the response of the oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, its fāʿil being latent, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response of an oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted. ﴿وَلَئِنْ كَفَرْتُمْ﴾ parsed like the preceding: in is conditional, and a past verb and its fāʿil, which is the protasis; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّ عَذابِي لَشَدِيدٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar, with the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَقالَ مُوسى﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ تَكْفُرُوا﴾ in is conditional, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; it is the protasis. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ in the position of nominative as tawkīd (emphasis) of the fāʿil. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ a relative noun conjoined to the wāw. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ﴾ the fāʾ connects the apodosis (rābiṭa), inna, and the Divine Name is its noun, غني and حميد are its two khabars, with the shifted lām; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿أَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is interrogative, and lam is a jussive particle. ﴿يَأْتِكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the mīm marks the plural. ﴿نَبَؤُا﴾ fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ a badal (substitute) of الذين, genitive (majrūr). ﴿نُوحٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَعادٍ﴾ conjoined to نوح. ﴿وَثَمُودَ﴾ conjoined, genitive with the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined. ﴿لا يَعْلَمُهُمْ إِلَّا اللَّهُ﴾ lā is negative, and an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and the Divine Name is fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is a parenthetical clause. ﴿جاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِالْبَيِّناتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جاءتهم; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَرَدُّوا أَيْدِيَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي أَفْواهِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ردوا. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿كَفَرْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿بِما﴾ mā is a relative; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to كفرنا. ﴿أُرْسِلْتُمْ﴾ a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أرسلتم. ﴿وَإِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَفِي شَكٍّ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ min and the relative mā, attached to شك. ﴿تَدْعُونَنا﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تدعوننا. ﴿مُرِيبٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of شك.

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿قالَتْ رُسُلُهُمْ﴾ a past verb, the tāʾ is for the feminine, and رسلهم is fāʿil (agent); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَفِي اللَّهِ﴾ the hamza is interrogative, and the Divine Name is genitive by في; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿شَكٌّ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فاطِرِ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of الله. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السموات. ﴿يَدْعُوكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the wāw owing to heaviness, its fāʿil being latent (mustatir); the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the mīm marks the plural; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لِيَغْفِرَ﴾ the lām is causal (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), its fāʿil being latent; an and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to يدعوكم. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يغفر. ﴿مِنْ ذُنُوبِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يغفر; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيُؤَخِّرَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, its fāʿil being omitted; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلى أَجَلٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يؤخركم. ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾ an adjective, genitive with an implied kasra on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negative. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بَشَرٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is the speech. ﴿مِثْلُنا﴾ an adjective of بشر; nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تُرِيدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾ the particle of the subjunctive (nāṣiba). «[Translator's note: so written in the source; the verse reads أَنْ تَصُدُّونا.]» ﴿تَصُدُّونا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and nā is mafʿūl bihi; the clause formed from an and the verb is to be interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of تريدون. ﴿عَمَّا﴾ mā is a relative; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to تصدونا. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is omitted; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يَعْبُدُ آباؤُنا﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; nā is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the khabar of kāna. ﴿فَأْتُونا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an unstated condition), and an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿بِسُلْطانٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أتونا. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective of سلطان.

daas-irab:11-12.t: ﴿قالَتْ لَهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ﴾ a past verb, the tāʾ is for the feminine, and رسلهم is a postponed fāʿil (agent); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); لهم is attached to (mutaʿalliq) قالت; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negative. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بَشَرٌ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مِثْلُكُمْ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَلكِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ lākinna is a particle resembling the verb, and the Divine Name is its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَمُنُّ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is the khabar. ﴿عَلى مَنْ﴾ man is a relative; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to يمن. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ عِبادِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negative. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the fronted khabar of kāna; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾ the particle of the subjunctive (nāṣiba). «[Translator's note: so written in the source; the verse reads أَنْ نَأْتِيَكُمْ.]» ﴿نَأْتِيَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), is the noun of kāna. ﴿بِسُلْطانٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نأتيكم. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿بِإِذْنِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. «[Translator's note: the source vocalises the word here as اللَّهَ though it parses it as genitive (اللَّهِ).]» ﴿وَعَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the Divine Name is genitive by على; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to يتوكل. ﴿فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and the lām of command, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ fāʿil, nominative with the wāw; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما لَنا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and mā is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ; لنا is attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَلَّا﴾ an, the particle of the subjunctive, and lā, negative. ﴿نَتَوَكَّلَ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, genitive by على; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿هَدانا﴾ a past verb and its first mafʿūl bihi, its fāʿil being latent. ﴿سُبُلَنا﴾ its second mafʿūl bihi, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَلَنَصْبِرَنَّ﴾ a conjunction, and an imperfect verb made indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the lām occurs in the response of the omitted oath. ﴿عَلى ما﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿آذَيْتُمُونا﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the wāw is for lengthening the ḍamma; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَعَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, genitive by على; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to يتوكل, and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and an imperfect verb, jussive by the lām of command. ﴿الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ﴾ fāʿil, nominative with the wāw; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:13-15.t:
﴿وَقالَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a past verb, and the relative noun is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).
﴿لِرُسُلِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قال. ﴿لَنُخْرِجَنَّكُمْ﴾ the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, its fāʿil being latent (mustatir), and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response of an oath. ﴿مِنْ أَرْضِنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نخرجنكم; the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لَتَعُودُنَّ﴾ conjoined to نخرجنكم; it is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil. ﴿فِي مِلَّتِنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to لتعودن. ﴿فَأَوْحى إِلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أوحى; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined by the fāʾ. ﴿لَنُهْلِكَنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, its fāʿil being latent, and الظالمين is its mafʿūl bihi; the lām paves the way for the oath; the clause of the response of the oath has no grammatical position. ﴿وَلَنُسْكِنَنَّكُمُ الْأَرْضَ﴾ parsed like لنهلكن: an imperfect verb, and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi, and الأرض is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. «في الأرض»; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before it. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿خافَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is omitted. ﴿مَقامِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَخافَ﴾ conjoined to خاف. ﴿وَعِيدِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the omitted yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ of the first person is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَاسْتَفْتَحُوا﴾ the wāw is a particle of resumption, and a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَخابَ كُلُّ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿جَبَّارٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَنِيدٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa).

daas-irab:16-18.t: ﴿مِنْ وَرائِهِ جَهَنَّمُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate); the clause is a second adjective (ṣifa) of جبار. ﴿وَيُسْقى﴾ a passive imperfect verb, whose nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ ماءٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يسقى. ﴿صَدِيدٍ﴾ a badal (substitute) of ماء. ﴿يَتَجَرَّعُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is omitted, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive or an adjective of ماء. ﴿وَلا يَكادُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negative, and يكاد is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb whose noun is omitted; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يُسِيغُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar. ﴿وَيَأْتِيهِ الْمَوْتُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness, its fronted mafʿūl bihi and its postponed fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يأتيه. ﴿مَكانٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَما هُوَ بِمَيِّتٍ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), mā operates like laysa, هو is in the position of nominative as its noun, the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and ميت is the khabar, genitive in form and accusative in position; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَمِنْ وَرائِهِ عَذابٌ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a postponed mubtadaʾ, and [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to a fronted khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿غَلِيظٌ﴾ an adjective of عذاب. ﴿مَثَلُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِرَبِّهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كفروا. ﴿أَعْمالُهُمْ كَرَمادٍ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to the khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿اشْتَدَّتْ بِهِ الرِّيحُ﴾ a past verb, the tāʾ is for the feminine, الريح is its fāʿil, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to اشتدت; the clause is an adjective of رماد. ﴿فِي يَوْمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اشتدت. ﴿عاصِفٍ﴾ an adjective of يوم. ﴿لا يَقْدِرُونَ﴾ lā is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ mā is a relative; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿كَسَبُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿عَلى شَيْءٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يقدرون. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a second mubtadaʾ. ﴿الضَّلالُ﴾ the khabar of هو; the clause is the khabar of ذلك. ﴿الْبَعِيدُ﴾ an adjective of الضلال.

daas-irab:19-21.t: ﴿أَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is interrogative, and lam is jussive. ﴿تَرَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter, and its fāʿil (agent) is omitted; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ anna, and the Divine Name is its noun; anna and what follows it take the place of the two objects of تر. ﴿خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil being latent (mustatir), and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ conjoined to السموات, accusative like it. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلق. ﴿إِنْ يَشَأْ﴾ in is conditional, and an imperfect verb, jussive, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil being latent; the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿يُذْهِبْكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), its fāʿil being latent, and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a condition not joined to the fāʾ. ﴿وَيَأْتِ﴾ an imperfect verb conjoined to what preceded, jussive like it, its fāʿil being latent. ﴿بِخَلْقٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يأت. ﴿جَدِيدٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a particle of resumption, and mā operates like laysa. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative, the lām is for distance and the kāf for address; it is in the position of nominative as the noun of mā. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, genitive by على; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to عزيز. ﴿بِعَزِيزٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and عزيز is the khabar of mā, genitive in form and accusative in position. ﴿وَبَرَزُوا﴾ the wāw is a particle of resumption, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, genitive by the lām; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to برزوا. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَقالَ الضُّعَفاءُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ a relative; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to قال. ﴿اسْتَكْبَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعاً﴾ kāna, its noun and its khabar, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تبعا; the clause is the khabar of إنا. ﴿فَهَلْ﴾ the fāʾ is a particle of resumption, and hal is an interrogative particle. ﴿أَنْتُمْ مُغْنُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَنَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مغنون. ﴿مِنْ عَذابِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مغنون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ min is a redundant preposition, and شيء is genitive in form and accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi of the active participle مغنون. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ﴾ a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿هَدانَا﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, fāʿil; the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. «[Translator's note: the source vocalises the word here as اللَّهِ though it parses it as fāʿil (اللَّهُ).]» ﴿لَهَدَيْناكُمْ﴾ the lām occurs in the apodosis of the condition, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿سَواءٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to سواء. ﴿أَجَزِعْنا﴾ the hamza is of equivalence (taswiya), and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause formed from the hamza of equivalence and what follows it is the speech. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿صَبَرْنا﴾ conjoined to جزعنا. ﴿ما لَنا﴾ mā operates like laysa, and لنا is attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ مَحِيصٍ﴾ min is a redundant preposition, and محيص is the noun of mā, genitive in form and nominative in position; the clause is the speech.

daas-irab:22-22.t: ﴿وَقالَ الشَّيْطانُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَمَّا﴾ an adverb meaning "when" (ḥīna). ﴿قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ﴾ a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Divine Name is its noun; the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَعَدَكُمْ وَعْدَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and وعد is its object and a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿الْحَقِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَوَعَدْتُكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to the khabar. ﴿فَأَخْلَفْتُكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negative. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the fronted khabar. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿سُلْطانٍ﴾ the noun of kāna, genitive in form and nominative in position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿أَنْ دَعَوْتُكُمْ﴾ an is lightened (mukhaffafa). ﴿دَعَوْتُكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; an and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of accusative as a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ). ﴿فَاسْتَجَبْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined by the fāʾ. ﴿لِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to استجبتم. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an unstated condition), and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَلُومُونِي﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿وَلُومُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْفُسَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ما أَنَا﴾ mā operates like laysa, and أنا is its noun. ﴿بِمُصْرِخِكُمْ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant, and مصرخكم is genitive in form and accusative in position, the khabar; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿وَما أَنْتُمْ بِمُصْرِخِيَّ﴾ parsed like the preceding. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna, and the yāʾ is its noun. ﴿كَفَرْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿بِما﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كفرت. ﴿أَشْرَكْتُمُونِ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the wāw is for lengthening (ishbāʿ), the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أشركتموني. ﴿إِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذابٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to عذاب. ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:23-25.t: ﴿وَأُدْخِلَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿جَنَّاتٍ﴾ a second mafʿūl bihi by extension (tawassuʿ). ﴿تَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness. ﴿مِنْ تَحْتِهَا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تجري. ﴿الْأَنْهارُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of جنات. ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خالدين. ﴿بِإِذْنِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أدخل. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَحِيَّتُهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تحية. ﴿سَلامٌ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿أَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is interrogative, and lam is a jussive particle. ﴿تَرَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun, ḥāl. ﴿ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil. ﴿مَثَلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَلِمَةً﴾ a badal (substitute) of مثلا. ﴿طَيِّبَةً﴾ an adjective of كلمة. ﴿كَشَجَرَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to a second adjective of كلمة, and طيبة is an adjective of شجرة. ﴿أَصْلُها ثابِتٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is a second adjective of شجرة. ﴿وَفَرْعُها﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي السَّماءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿تُؤْتِي أُكُلَها﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness, its fāʿil being latent (mustatir), and أكلها is mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive or a ḥāl. ﴿كُلَّ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿حِينٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِإِذْنِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تؤتي. ﴿رَبِّها﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ الْأَمْثالَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil, and الأمثال its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يضرب. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ laʿalla and its noun; the clause is causal, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَتَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar.

daas-irab:26-27.t: ﴿وَمَثَلُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and مثل is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَلِمَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿خَبِيثَةٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿كَشَجَرَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿خَبِيثَةٍ﴾ an adjective of شجرة; the clause is conjoined to what preceded. ﴿اجْتُثَّتْ﴾ a passive past verb, the tāʾ is for the feminine, and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted; the clause is a second adjective of شجرة. ﴿مِنْ فَوْقِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اجتثت. ﴿الْأَرْضِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ما لَها﴾ mā is negative, and لها is attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿قَرارٍ﴾ mubtadaʾ, genitive in form and nominative in position; the clause is a second adjective of شجرة. ﴿يُثَبِّتُ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the Divine Name is fāʿil (agent). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِالْقَوْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يثبت. ﴿الثَّابِتِ﴾ an adjective. ﴿فِي الْحَياةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb يثبت. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective, genitive (majrūr) with an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ﴾ conjoined to الدنيا. ﴿وَيُضِلُّ اللَّهُ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil, and الظالمين its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَيَفْعَلُ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما يَشاءُ﴾ mā is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila.

daas-irab:28-31.t: ﴿أَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is interrogative; lam is a jussive particle. ﴿تَرَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَى الَّذِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تر, and it takes the place of the two objects of تر. ﴿بَدَّلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿نِعْمَتَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كُفْراً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَحَلُّوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قَوْمَهُمْ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿دارَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْبَوارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾ a badal (substitute) of دار. ﴿يَصْلَوْنَها﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَبِئْسَ الْقَرارُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive. ﴿بِئْسَ﴾ a past verb for expressing blame. ﴿الْقَرارُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَجَعَلُوا لِلَّهِ أَنْداداً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi, and the Divine Name is genitive by the lām, [the preposition and its genitive noun] being attached to the second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِيُضِلُّوا﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and the imperfect verb is accusative (manṣūb) by the implied an, by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before it, as are the lām and what follows it; the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَمَتَّعُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَإِنَّ مَصِيرَكُمْ إِلَى النَّارِ﴾ inna and its noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is causal. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِعِبادِيَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قل; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, adjective (ṣifa) of عبادي. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿يُقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the response to the command (jawāb al-ṭalab), by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the speech, and الصلاة is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَيُنْفِقُوا﴾ conjoined to يقيموا and parsed like it. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ min is a preposition and mā a relative; [they are] attached to ينفقوا. ﴿رَزَقْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿سِرًّا﴾ ḥāl. ﴿وَعَلانِيَةً﴾ conjoined to سرا. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ينفق. ﴿أَنْ﴾ the particle of the subjunctive (nāṣiba). ﴿يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لا بَيْعٌ﴾ lā is negative, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِيهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar. ﴿وَلا خِلالٌ﴾ conjoined to لا بيع; the clause is an adjective of يوم.

daas-irab:32-34.t: ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, khabar (predicate). ﴿خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ﴾ a past verb and its object, genitive (majrūr) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural, its fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). «[Translator's note: so in the source ("genitive"); as mafʿūl bihi the word is accusative, marked with the kasra.]» ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ conjoined to السموات, accusative (manṣūb) like it. ﴿وَأَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and ماء is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزل; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَأَخْرَجَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined by the fāʾ. ﴿بِهِ مِنَ الثَّمَراتِ﴾ the two prepositions and their genitive nouns are attached to أخرج. ﴿رِزْقاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi or mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to رزقا. ﴿وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْفُلْكَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and الفلك is its mafʿūl bihi, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to سخر; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِتَجْرِيَ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the lām of causation, its fāʿil being latent; an and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), are genitive by the lām, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to سخر. ﴿فِي الْبَحْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تجري. ﴿بِأَمْرِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تجري; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْأَنْهارَ﴾ conjoined to سخر لكم الفلك; it is like it, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الشَّمْسَ﴾ the clause is conjoined to what preceded and is parsed like it. ﴿وَالْقَمَرَ﴾ conjoined to الشمس. ﴿دائِبَيْنِ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to سخر, its fāʿil being latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَالنَّهارَ﴾ conjoined to الليل. ﴿وَآتاكُمْ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آتاكم. ﴿ما﴾ a relative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿سَأَلْتُمُوهُ﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is its fāʿil, the wāw is for lengthening (ishbāʿ), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَإِنْ تَعُدُّوا﴾ in is conditional, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause of the protasis has no grammatical position. ﴿نِعْمَتَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا تُحْصُوها﴾ lā is negative, and an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a condition not joined to the fāʾ. ﴿إِنَّ الْإِنْسانَ لَظَلُومٌ كَفَّارٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its two khabars, and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:35-36.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of resumption, and idh is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر"; its clause is resumptive. ﴿قالَ إِبْراهِيمُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) because it is muḍāf, and the yāʾ, omitted for lightness, is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اجْعَلْ﴾ a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿هَذَا﴾ ذا is a demonstrative in the position of accusative as first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is for alerting (tanbīh). ﴿الْبَلَدَ﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿آمِناً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَاجْنُبْنِي﴾ a verb of supplication; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is in the position of accusative as first mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what preceded. ﴿وَبَنِيَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and بني is conjoined to the yāʾ in اجنبني, accusative like it, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنْ نَعْبُدَ﴾ an is the particle of the subjunctive (nāṣiba), and an imperfect verb, accusative, its fāʿil being latent; an and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of accusative as second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْأَصْنامَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of نعبد. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed, with an omitted vocative particle, accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person; the yāʾ, omitted for lightness, is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّهُنَّ﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is the speech. ﴿أَضْلَلْنَ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is the fāʿil. ﴿كَثِيراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿مِنَ النَّاسِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أضللن. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and man is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿تَبِعَنِي﴾ a past verb; the nūn is for protection and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause, together with the clause of the apodosis, is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿فَإِنَّهُ﴾ the fāʾ connects the apodosis (rābiṭa), and inna and its noun; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and ﴿مِنِّي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿وَمَنْ عَصانِي﴾ conjoined to من تبعني. ﴿فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its two khabars; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:37-37.t: ﴿رَبَّنا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), with an omitted vocative particle, accusative (manṣūb), and nā is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the vocative clause has no grammatical position. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَسْكَنْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أسكنت; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِوادٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أسكنت. ﴿غَيْرِ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of واد. ﴿ذِي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿زَرْعٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to أسكنت. ﴿بَيْتِكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْمُحَرَّمِ﴾ an adjective of بيتك. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾ the one addressed, with an omitted [vocative] particle, accusative, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِيُقِيمُوا﴾ the lām is causal (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun — made up of the lām and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) — are attached to أسكنت. ﴿الصَّلاةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَاجْعَلْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an unstated condition), and a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the clause of the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿أَفْئِدَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ النَّاسِ﴾ an adjective of أفئدة. ﴿تَهْوِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness, its fāʿil being latent. ﴿إِلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تهوي. ﴿وَارْزُقْهُمْ﴾ a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; it is conjoined to what preceded. ﴿مِنَ الثَّمَراتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ارزقهم. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ laʿalla and its noun. ﴿يَشْكُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of laʿalla, and the clause of laʿalla with its noun and khabar is causal, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:38-40.t: ﴿رَبَّنا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), with an omitted vocative particle, accusative (manṣūb), and nā is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the vocative clause has no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنك. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿نُخْفِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness, its fāʿil being latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَما﴾ conjoined to the preceding ما. ﴿نُعْلِنُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a particle of resumption, and mā is negative. ﴿يَخْفى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, genitive by على; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يخفى. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ fāʿil, genitive in form and nominative in position. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of شيء. ﴿وَلا فِي السَّماءِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, lā is redundant, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of شيء. ﴿الْحَمْدُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, genitive by the lām; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative, adjective of الله. ﴿وَهَبَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿لِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to وهب. ﴿عَلَى الْكِبَرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِسْماعِيلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَإِسْحاقَ﴾ conjoined to إسماعيل. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي﴾ inna and its noun, accusative with an implied fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, its appearance being prevented by the place being occupied by the fitting vowel; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَسَمِيعُ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and سميع is the khabar of inna. ﴿الدُّعاءِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed, with an omitted [vocative] particle, accusative with an implied fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, which is omitted for lightness; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اجْعَلْنِي﴾ a verb of supplication; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مُقِيمَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الصَّلاةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to the yāʾ of the first person in اجعلني, and the yāʾ of the first person is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾ the one addressed, with an omitted vocative particle, accusative, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَتَقَبَّلْ﴾ a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿دُعاءِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with an implied fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, its appearance being prevented by the place being occupied by the fitting vowel; the omitted yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and it was omitted for lightness; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:41-42.t: ﴿رَبَّنَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with the omitted yāʾ, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «[Translator's note: so in the source; the usual analysis is "with an omitted vocative particle (yā)".]» ﴿اغْفِرْ﴾ a verb of supplication whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) اغفر. ﴿وَلِوالِدَيَّ﴾ conjoined to لي. ﴿وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ conjoined to والدي. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يَقُومُ الْحِسابُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is resumptive. ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿تَحْسَبَنَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the clause is in the position of jussive (majzūm) by lā, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿اللَّهَ غافِلًا﴾ the two objects of تحسبن. ﴿عَمَّا﴾ ʿan is a preposition and mā a relative noun; [they are] attached to غافلا. ﴿يَعْمَلُ الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its fāʿil being latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِيَوْمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يؤخرهم. ﴿تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ الْأَبْصارُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تشخص; the clause تشخص is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:43-44.t: ﴿مُهْطِعِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿مُقْنِعِي﴾ ḥāl, accusative with the yāʾ; the nūn is dropped because of annexation. ﴿رُؤُسِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَرْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يرتد; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl, or resumptive. ﴿وَأَفْئِدَتُهُمْ هَواءٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the hāʾ in أفئدتهم is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive or a ḥāl. ﴿وَأَنْذِرِ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿النَّاسَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what preceded. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَأْتِيهِمُ الْعَذابُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَيَقُولُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿يقول﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿رَبَّنا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), with an omitted vocative particle, accusative, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَخِّرْنا﴾ a verb of supplication and its fāʿil; the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِلى أَجَلٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخرنا. ﴿قَرِيبٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of أجل. ﴿نُجِبْ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; it is jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab); the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿دَعْوَتَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَنَتَّبِعِ﴾ conjoined to نجب, jussive like it, its fāʿil being latent; it is given a kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters. ﴿الرُّسُلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative. ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is interrogative and the wāw a conjunction; lam is jussive. ﴿تَكُونُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive, and the wāw is its noun; the clause is the speech of an omitted verb, i.e. "فيقال لهم هذا القول" («and this will be said to them»). ﴿أَقْسَمْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أقسمتم. ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿زَوالٍ﴾ khabar, genitive in form and nominative in position; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response of an oath. «[Translator's note: so in the source ("khabar"); in the analysis of the preceding words زوال is the postponed subject.]»

daas-irab:45-46.t: ﴿وَسَكَنْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the mīm marks the plural; the clause is conjoined to أقسمتم. ﴿فِي مَساكِنِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) سكنتم. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَتَبَيَّنَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to what preceded. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تبين. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) or ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَعَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فعلنا; the clause is explicative, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَضَرَبْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what preceded. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ضربنا. ﴿الْأَمْثالَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿مَكَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَكْرَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿وَعِنْدَ اللَّهِ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and عند is an adverb of place attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَكْرَهُمْ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and in is negative. ﴿كانَ مَكْرُهُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِتَزُولَ﴾ the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive [and attached to] the khabar of kāna; [تزول is] an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of denial. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تزول. ﴿الْجِبالُ﴾ fāʿil.

daas-irab:47-50.t: ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَحْسَبَنَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, its fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir). ﴿اللَّهَ مُخْلِفَ﴾ the two objects of تحسبن. ﴿وَعْدِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; it is in origin the second object of مخلف. ﴿رُسُلَهُ﴾ the first object of مخلف, because مخلف is an active participle. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ﴾ inna, the Divine Name is its noun, and عزيز its khabar (predicate). ﴿ذُو﴾ a second khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is one of the five nouns. ﴿انتِقامٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is causal, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time, badal (substitute) of يوم يأتيهم. ﴿تُبَدَّلُ الْأَرْضُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿غَيْرَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الأرض was its first object and became the nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿الْأَرْضُ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. «[Translator's note: the source vocalises the word here as الْأَرْضُ though it parses it as genitive (الْأَرْضِ).]» ﴿وَبَرَزُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to the preceding one. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, genitive; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) برزوا. ﴿الْواحِدِ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of الله. ﴿الْقَهَّارِ﴾ a second adjective. ﴿وَتَرَى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif, its fāʿil being latent. ﴿الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مُقَرَّنِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿فِي الْأَصْفادِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مقرنين. ﴿سَرابِيلُهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ قَطِرانٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَتَغْشى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿وُجُوهَهُمُ﴾ a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿النَّارُ﴾ a postponed fāʿil; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:51-52.t: ﴿لِيَجْزِيَ اللَّهُ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of causation; the preposition and its genitive noun — made up of the lām of causation, the implied an and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) — are attached to (mutaʿalliq) برزوا; the Divine Name is fāʿil (agent). ﴿كُلَّ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿نَفْسٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ما﴾ a relative in the position of accusative as second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَسَبَتْ﴾ a past verb, the tāʾ is for the feminine, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسابِ﴾ inna, the Divine Name is its noun, سريع its khabar (predicate), and الحساب is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿هذا﴾ the hāʾ is for alerting (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بَلاغٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بلاغ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلِيُنْذَرُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and the lām is causal, and a passive imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the lām of causation, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; an and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar, are genitive by the lām of causation, and [they are] attached to an omitted [verb], its implied form being "لينصحوا ولينذروا". «[Translator's note: so in the source ("fāʿil"); with a passive verb the wāw would ordinarily be called nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).]» ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ينذروا. ﴿وَلِيَعْلَمُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the lām of causation, and the wāw is the fāʿil; it is conjoined. ﴿أَنَّما﴾ the restraining and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿هُوَ إِلهٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; anna and what follows it take the place of the two objects of يعلموا. ﴿واحِدٌ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of إله. ﴿وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and the lām is causal, and an imperfect verb, accusative by an; it is conjoined to what preceded. ﴿أُولُوا﴾ fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. ﴿الْأَلْبابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.
